# A framework the register does not place

`Policy: pol-UNPL` `ACTIVE`

## Purpose

To cite a framework the register says nothing about. Without a standing to read there is no answer to
whether the reference binds, so the roll-up would leave it out and the generated index would
under-report what this policy covers with nothing saying so.

## Scope

Every service in the estate.

## Clauses

| Id      | Clause                                              | Alignment                 |
|---------|-----------------------------------------------------|---------------------------|
| `PLACE` | **MUST** place a framework before a clause cites it. | [ISO 27001:2022].A.5.1    |
| `AGAIN` | **MUST NOT** be told the same thing twice.           | [ISO 27001:2022].A.5.2    |

[ISO 27001:2022]: ../frameworks.md#unplaced
